device_name: CREO Side Loading Pedicle Screw System

specs.Features: Polyaxial Head , Fixed Head , 0-Profile Top Loading Rod
specs.By Location/Approach: Posterior Thoracic , Posterior Lumbar , Posterior Sacral

description:
CREO Side Loading:
The CREO Side Loading Pedicle Screw stabilization system by Globus Medical is a non modular polyaxial screw fixation system with a lateral capture of the rod. The locking sleeve captured and hold the rod in place before final tightening. The system comes with multiple screw options
Screw Options:
Monoaxial Screw: Double threaded, blunt tip Screw sizes:  4.0, 4.5, 5.0, 5.5, 6.0, 6.5, 7.5, 8.5, 9.5, and 10.5mm Screw lengths: 20–120mm  Accept 5.5mm or 6.0mm diameter rod Polyaxial Screws: Double threaded, blunt tip  ±30° angulation (60° total)  Screw diameters: 4.0, 4.5, 5.0, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5, 8.5, 9.5, and 10.5mm  Screw lengths 20–120mm  Accept 5.5mm or 6.0mm diameter rod Uniplanar Screws: Deformity correction screws  ±20° angulation in cranial/caudal direction  Screw diameters: 4.0, 4.5, 5.0, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5, and 8.5mm  Screw lengths: 20-65mm
	Accept 5.5mm or 6.0mm diameter rod Dual Outer Diameter (DOD) Screws: Designed for Sacro-iliac fixation
	Nominal diameter at distal end allows for deeper insertion in sacrum without perforation  ±30° angulation (60° total)  Available in proximal/distal outer diameters: 8.0/6.5, 8.5/7.0, 9.5/8.0, and 10.5/9.0mm  Screw lengths: 70–120mm
